search_window.basis: Since prior completed hourly recall watch

coverage_notes.coverage: Targeted official/local reporting for hospital and ED closures, maternity, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, rural/emergency service loss, ambulance/air-medical shutdown, essential-service restorations, and U.S. territories.
coverage_notes.exclusions: Older or duplicate changes (including Roseland maternity announcement), future proposals without concrete access effect, ownership-only stories, opinion and foreign/nonqualifying reports.
coverage_notes.observation: No newly confirmed qualifying development in the bounded observation window; web indexing may lag local notices.
